        items = await asyncio.to_thread(self.service.delegations.items,identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        personal=await asyncio.to_thread(self.service.personal.store(identity['team'],identity['owner']).summary)
        return web.json_response({'items':items,'personal_info':personal,'csrf':identity['csrf']})

    async def personal_details(self, request):
        identity=self.identity(request,csrf=True);data=await request.json()
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'kind'}:raise AccessError('Choose the personal detail to edit.')
        store=self.service.personal.store(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        fields=await asyncio.to_thread(store.values,data['kind'])
        return web.json_response({'fields':fields or {}})

    async def personal_save(self, request):
        identity=self.identity(request,csrf=True);data=await request.json()
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'kind','fields'}:raise AccessError('Use only the fields in this personal info form.')
        home=self.service.private_home(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        def save():
            with self.service.lock_for(home):
                store=self.service.personal.store(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
                store.save(data['kind'],data['fields'])
                return store.summary()
        return web.json_response({'saved':True,'personal_info':await asyncio.to_thread(save)})

    async def personal_remove(self, request):
        identity=self.identity(request,csrf=True);data=await request.json()
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'kind'}:raise AccessError('Choose the personal detail to remove.')
        home=self.service.private_home(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        def remove():
            with self.service.lock_for(home):
                store=self.service.personal.store(identity['team'],identity['owner'])
                store.remove(data['kind'])
                return store.summary()
        return web.json_response({'removed':True,'personal_info':await asyncio.to_thread(remove)})

    async def invitations(self, request):
        identity = self.identity(request)
        data = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'handle'}:
            raise AccessError('Choose one of your saved credentials.')
        invitations = await asyncio.to_thread(self.service.delegations.invitations,identity,data['handle'])
        members = await self.service.invitation_members(identity)
        items = await asyncio.to_thread(self.service.delegations.items,identity['team'],identity['owner'])
        credentials = [item for item in items if item.get('access') != 'invited' and item['kind'] in ('login','api_key','payment')]
        return web.json_response({'invitations':invitations,'members':members,'credentials':credentials,'csrf':identity['csrf']})

    async def invite(self, request):
        identity = self.identity(request,csrf=True)
        data = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'handles','recipient'}:
            raise AccessError('Choose a Slack member and the credentials to share.')
        return web.json_response(await self.service.set_invitation_access(identity,data['recipient'],data['handles']))

    async def revoke_invitation(self, request):
        identity = self.identity(request,csrf=True)
        data = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'id'}:
            raise AccessError('Choose an invitation to revoke.')
        return web.json_response(await self.service.revoke_invitation(identity,data['id']))

    async def code(self, request):
        identity=self.identity(request,csrf=True)
        data=await request.json()
        return_url=self.return_slack_url(identity)
        label=await asyncio.to_thread(self.service.save_code,data['id'],data['token'],identity,data['fields'])
        return web.json_response({'saved':True,'label':label,'return_slack_url':return_url})

    async def disconnect(self, request):
        identity = self.identity(request,csrf=True)
        data = await request.json()
        await self.service.disconnect(identity['team'],identity['owner'],data['handle'])
        return web.json_response({'removed':True})

    async def start(self):
        self.runner = web.AppRunner(self.app,access_log=None)
        await self.runner.setup()
        await web.TCPSite(self.runner,'127.0.0.1',int(self.config.get('port',8767))).start()

    async def close(self):
        await self.runner.cleanup()

"""Real owner-authenticated HTTP and native encrypted persistence for personal info."""
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer
from test_clanker_vault import service, request
from agent.vault_store import VaultStore
from agent.vault_login_classifier import LoginControl
from vault.personal import PersonalStore, personal_fills, exact_origin, validate
from vault.store import AccessError
from vault.web import VaultWeb
from test_clanker_phone_login import turn

ADDRESS={'address_line1':'42 Example Street','address_line2':'Flat 4','city':'Pune','state':'Maharashtra','postal_code':'411001','country':'India'}
PHONE={'phone_number':'+91 98765 43210','country_code':'+91'}


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_private_crud_is_encrypted_durable_owner_scoped_and_csrf_protected(service):
    http=TestClient(TestServer(VaultWeb(service,service.config).app));await http.start_server()
    try:
        saved={}
        for owner,kind,fields in [('UA','phone',PHONE),('UB','email',{'email':'second@example.invalid'}),('UA','email',{'email':'first@example.invalid'}),('UA','address',ADDRESS)]:
            sid=service.store.new_session('TT',owner)
            headers={'Origin':'https://vault.example','Cookie':'__Host-clanker='+sid,'X-CSRF-Token':service.store.session(sid)['csrf']}
            response=await http.post('/api/personal/save',json={'kind':kind,'fields':fields},headers=headers)
            result=await response.json();assert response.status==200,result
            assert result['personal_info'][kind]['saved']
            assert all(value not in json.dumps(result) for value in fields.values() if len(value)>4)
            store=PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT',owner))
            assert store.values(kind)==validate(kind,fields)
            for path in (store._vault_path,service.store.path):
                assert all(value.encode() not in path.read_bytes() for value in fields.values())
            assert (store._vault_path.stat().st_mode&0o777)==0o600
            assert VaultStore(service.private_home('TT',owner)/'vault').list_items()==[]
            response=await http.post('/api/personal/details',json={'kind':kind},headers=headers)
            assert (await response.json())['fields']==validate(kind,fields)
            response=await http.post('/api/personal/details',json={'kind':kind},headers=headers|{'X-CSRF-Token':'bad'})
            assert response.status==403
            response=await http.post('/api/personal/save',json={'kind':kind,'fields':fields,'owner':'UB'},headers=headers)
            assert response.status==400
            response=await http.post('/api/personal/save',json={'kind':kind,'fields':fields},headers=headers|{'Origin':'https://evil.invalid'})
            assert response.status==403
            saved[owner]=headers
        assert PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT','UB')).values('phone') is None
        assert PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT','UB')).values('address') is None
        headers=saved['UA'];response=await http.post('/api/personal/save',json={'kind':'email','fields':{'email':'changed@example.invalid'}},headers=headers)
        assert response.status==200
        assert PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT','UA')).values('email')['email']=='changed@example.invalid'
        response=await http.post('/api/personal/remove',json={'kind':'phone'},headers=headers)
        assert response.status==200 and not (await response.json())['personal_info']['phone']['saved']
        assert PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT','UA')).values('phone') is None
        assert PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT','UB')).values('email')['email']=='second@example.invalid'
        response=await http.post('/api/personal/details',json={'kind':'email'},headers={'Origin':'https://vault.example'})
        assert response.status==401
    finally:await http.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_primary_phone_is_reused_on_new_origins_but_site_accounts_win(service):
    owner_home=service.private_home('TT','UA');PersonalStore(owner_home).save('phone',PHONE)
    service.cloud_browser=SimpleNamespace(login_origin=lambda *a,**kw:'https://first.example')
    first=await service.request_access(turn(service),login_method='sms')
    assert first['status']=='access_ready' and first['origin']=='https://first.example'
    assert '+91' not in json.dumps(first) and '9876543210' not in json.dumps(first)
    again=await service.request_access(turn(service),login_method='sms')
    assert again['handle']==first['handle']
    service.cloud_browser.login_origin=lambda *a,**kw:'https://second.example'
    second=await service.request_access(turn(service),login_method='sms')
    assert second['handle']!=first['handle']

"""Visible login/code detection and model-blind phone-number autofill."""
import json
import re
import secrets
from dataclasses import replace

from agent.vault_login_classifier import (
    LoginControl, ClassifiedLoginControl, build_inspection_js, build_fill_js, classify_login_control,
    classify_otp_controls, _RE_OTP,
)
from .store import AccessError


# Use the native inspection's visibility and label resolution in every backend.
_CONTROLS = 'JSON.parse(' + build_inspection_js('clanker-login-probe') + ')'
_TEXT = "(c.name+' '+c.label).replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g,'$1 $2').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi,' ')"
_OTP = "(c.autocomplete.split(/\\s+/).includes('one-time-code') || new RegExp(" + json.dumps(_RE_OTP.pattern) + ", 'i').test(" + _TEXT + '))'
_PHONE = "(!" + _OTP + " && (c.maxLength === null || c.maxLength >= 7) && !c.autocomplete.includes('tel-country-code') && !c.autocomplete.includes('tel-extension') && (c.type === 'tel' || c.autocomplete.split(/\\s+/).some(t => t === 'tel' || t === 'tel-national') || /\\b(phone|telephone|mobile|phonenumber|mobilenumber)\\b/i.test(" + _TEXT + ')))'
PHONE_FIELDS = '(' + _CONTROLS + ').some(c => ' + _PHONE + ')'
PASSWORD_FIELDS = '(' + _CONTROLS + ").some(c => c.type === 'password' && !c.autocomplete.includes('new-password') && !" + _OTP + ')'
LOGIN_FIELDS = '(' + _CONTROLS + ").some(c => !" + _OTP + " && (c.type === 'password' && !c.autocomplete.includes('new-password') || c.type === 'email' || c.autocomplete.split(/\\s+/).includes('username') || /\\b(login|username|identifier)\\b/i.test(c.name) || " + _PHONE + '))'
OTP_FIELDS = '(() => {const controls=' + _CONTROLS + '; if(controls.some(c => ' + _OTP + '))return true; const boxes=controls.filter(c => c.maxLength===1 && ["text","tel","number"].includes(c.type)); return boxes.length>=4 && boxes.length<=8 && boxes.every((c,i) => c.formIndex===boxes[0].formIndex && (!i || c.index===boxes[i-1].index+1));})()'


def normalize_phone(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > 64 or not re.fullmatch(r'\+?[0-9\s().-]+', value.strip()):
        raise AccessError('Enter a phone number in the format requested by the website.')
    number = re.sub(r'[\s().-]', '', value.strip())
    if not re.fullmatch(r'\+?[0-9]{7,15}', number):
        raise AccessError('Enter a phone number with 7 to 15 digits, including the country code if required.')
    return number


def phone_fills(controls, number):
    controls = normalize_controls(controls)
    otp_indexes = {c.control.index for c in classify_otp_controls(controls)}
    candidates = []
    for control in controls:
        if (control.index in otp_indexes or control.max_length is not None and control.max_length < 7 or
                any(t in control.autocomplete.split() for t in ('tel-country-code', 'tel-extension'))):
            continue
        classified = classify_login_control(control)
        if classified and classified.token == 'tel':
            candidates.append(classified)
        elif (control.type in ('text', 'number', '') and
              (control.autocomplete == 'tel-national' or re.search(r'\b(phone|telephone|mobile|phonenumber|mobilenumber)\b',
               re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', re.sub(r'([a-z0-9])([A-Z])', r'\1 \2', control.name+' '+control.label).lower())))):
            candidates.append(ClassifiedLoginControl(control, 100 if control.autocomplete=='tel-national' else 70, 'tel'))
    if not candidates:
        raise AccessError('Open the phone-number login field before filling this account.', 409)
    score = max(c.score for c in candidates)
    best = [c for c in candidates if c.score == score]
    if len(best) != 1:
        raise AccessError('The phone-number field is ambiguous. Leave only the intended login form open.', 409)
    target = best[0]
    if target.control.max_length is not None and len(number) > target.control.max_length:
        raise AccessError('The saved number is too long for this field. Save it in the format requested by the website.', 409)
    return [{'index': target.control.index, 'token': 'tel', 'value': number}]


def normalize_controls(controls):
    return [replace(c, name=re.sub(r'([a-z0-9])([A-Z])', r'\1 \2', c.name),
                    label=re.sub(r'([a-z0-9])([A-Z])', r'\1 \2', c.label)) for c in controls]


def sms_otp_controls(controls):
    matched=classify_otp_controls(controls)
    if matched:return matched
    boxes=[c for c in controls if c.max_length==1 and c.type in ('text','tel','number')]
    if (4<=len(boxes)<=8 and len({c.form_index for c in boxes})==1 and
            all(b.index==a.index+1 for a,b in zip(boxes,boxes[1:]))):
        return [ClassifiedLoginControl(c,70,'one-time-code') for c in boxes]
    return []


def sms_code_fills(controls, code):
    from agent.vault_login_classifier import build_otp_fills
    matched=sms_otp_controls(controls)
    if not matched:
        raise AccessError('Open the SMS verification-code field before entering the code.', 409)
    boxes=[c for c in matched if c.control.max_length==1]
    if boxes and len(boxes)!=len(code):
        raise AccessError('The SMS code length does not match the website\'s verification fields.', 409)
    fills=build_otp_fills(matched,code)
    lengths={c.index:c.max_length for c in controls}
    if any(lengths[f['index']] is not None and len(f['value'])>lengths[f['index']] for f in fills):
        raise AccessError('The SMS code is too long for the website\'s verification field.', 409)
    return fills


def local_fill(turn, access, *, code=None):
    """Fill phone or SMS code without exposing the value to the model."""
    from tools import browser_vault_tool as native
    from agent.redact import register_vault_redaction_value
    service = turn.service
    service.assert_private(turn)
    service.delegations.resolve(turn, access.handle)
    service.delegations.check_execution(turn)
    if code is None and not access.grant_id:
        primary = service.personal.store(turn.source.scope_id, turn.source.user_id).values('phone')
        if primary and primary.get('country_code') and primary['phone_number'] == access.secret()['phone_number']:
            result = service.personal.fill(turn, origin=access.meta.origin, fields=['phone'])
            result['next'] = 'Use the website to request its SMS code, then call clanker_vault_enter_code with this handle. Never read or echo the filled phone number.'
            return result
    supervisor = native._ensure_supervisor(turn.task_id)
    if supervisor is None:
        raise AccessError('Start this task\'s private browser before filling the login.', 409)
    from seatbelt.context import Context
    Context(turn.home).owned_cdp(supervisor.cdp_url)
    focused = supervisor.focus_page(access.meta.origin, accept=OTP_FIELDS if code is not None else PHONE_FIELDS)
    if not focused.get('ok') or native._current_page_origin(turn.task_id) != access.meta.origin:
        raise AccessError('Open the matching account phone or verification form before filling it.', 403)
    nonce = secrets.token_hex(8)
    inspected = native._eval_js(turn.task_id, build_inspection_js(nonce))
    raw = native._parse_json_result(inspected.get('result')) if inspected.get('success') else None
    if isinstance(raw, str):raw = native._parse_json_result(raw)
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        raise AccessError('The phone login form could not be inspected.', 409)
    controls = normalize_controls([LoginControl.from_dict(c) for c in raw if isinstance(c, dict)])
    value = code if code is not None else access.secret()['phone_number']
    fills = sms_code_fills(controls, value) if code is not None else phone_fills(controls, value)
    if not fills:
        raise AccessError('Open the SMS verification-code field before entering the code.', 409)
    register_vault_redaction_value(value)
    if code is None:register_vault_redaction_value(value.lstrip('+'))
    service.delegations.record_browser_use(turn, access)
    filled = native._eval_js_secret(turn.task_id, build_fill_js(fills, expected_origin=access.meta.origin, nonce=nonce))
    data = native._parse_json_result(filled.get('result')) if filled.get('success') else None
    if isinstance(data, str):data = native._parse_json_result(data)
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get('refused') or not data.get('filled'):
        raise AccessError('The phone login fill was not confirmed.', 409)
    return {'success': True, 'filled_fields': data['filled'], 'origin': access.meta.origin,
            'next': ('Continue the website login and verify its result.' if code is not None else
                     'Use the website to request its SMS code, then call clanker_vault_enter_code with this handle. Never read or echo the filled phone number.')}

"""Real owner-authenticated HTTP and native encrypted persistence for personal info."""
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer
from test_clanker_vault import service, request
from agent.vault_store import VaultStore
from agent.vault_login_classifier import LoginControl
from vault.personal import PersonalStore, personal_fills, exact_origin, validate
from vault.store import AccessError
from vault.web import VaultWeb
from test_clanker_phone_login import turn

ADDRESS={'address_line1':'42 Example Street','address_line2':'Flat 4','city':'Pune','state':'Maharashtra','postal_code':'411001','country':'India'}
PHONE={'phone_number':'+91 98765 43210','country_code':'+91'}


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_private_crud_is_encrypted_durable_owner_scoped_and_csrf_protected(service):
    http=TestClient(TestServer(VaultWeb(service,service.config).app));await http.start_server()
    try:
        saved={}
        for owner,kind,fields in [('UA','phone',PHONE),('UB','email',{'email':'second@example.invalid'}),('UA','email',{'email':'first@example.invalid'}),('UA','address',ADDRESS)]:
            sid=service.store.new_session('TT',owner)
            headers={'Origin':'https://vault.example','Cookie':'__Host-clanker='+sid,'X-CSRF-Token':service.store.session(sid)['csrf']}
            response=await http.post('/api/personal/save',json={'kind':kind,'fields':fields},headers=headers)
            result=await response.json();assert response.status==200,result
            assert result['personal_info'][kind]['saved']
            assert all(value not in json.dumps(result) for value in fields.values() if len(value)>4)
            store=PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT',owner))
            assert store.values(kind)==validate(kind,fields)
            for path in (store._vault_path,service.store.path):
                assert all(value.encode() not in path.read_bytes() for value in fields.values())
            assert (store._vault_path.stat().st_mode&0o777)==0o600
            assert VaultStore(service.private_home('TT',owner)/'vault').list_items()==[]
            response=await http.post('/api/personal/details',json={'kind':kind},headers=headers)
            assert (await response.json())['fields']==validate(kind,fields)
            response=await http.post('/api/personal/details',json={'kind':kind},headers=headers|{'X-CSRF-Token':'bad'})
            assert response.status==403
            response=await http.post('/api/personal/save',json={'kind':kind,'fields':fields,'owner':'UB'},headers=headers)
            assert response.status==400
            response=await http.post('/api/personal/save',json={'kind':kind,'fields':fields},headers=headers|{'Origin':'https://evil.invalid'})
            assert response.status==403
            saved[owner]=headers
        assert PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT','UB')).values('phone') is None
        assert PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT','UB')).values('address') is None
        headers=saved['UA'];response=await http.post('/api/personal/save',json={'kind':'email','fields':{'email':'changed@example.invalid'}},headers=headers)
        assert response.status==200
        assert PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT','UA')).values('email')['email']=='changed@example.invalid'
        response=await http.post('/api/personal/remove',json={'kind':'phone'},headers=headers)
        assert response.status==200 and not (await response.json())['personal_info']['phone']['saved']
        assert PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT','UA')).values('phone') is None
        assert PersonalStore(service.private_home('TT','UB')).values('email')['email']=='second@example.invalid'
        response=await http.post('/api/personal/details',json={'kind':'email'},headers={'Origin':'https://vault.example'})
        assert response.status==401
    finally:await http.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_primary_phone_is_reused_on_new_origins_but_site_accounts_win(service):
    owner_home=service.private_home('TT','UA');PersonalStore(owner_home).save('phone',PHONE)
    service.cloud_browser=SimpleNamespace(login_origin=lambda *a,**kw:'https://first.example')
    first=await service.request_access(turn(service),login_method='sms')
    assert first['status']=='access_ready' and first['origin']=='https://first.example'
    assert '+91' not in json.dumps(first) and '9876543210' not in json.dumps(first)
    again=await service.request_access(turn(service),login_method='sms')
    assert again['handle']==first['handle']
    service.cloud_browser.login_origin=lambda *a,**kw:'https://second.example'
    second=await service.request_access(turn(service),login_method='sms')
    assert second['handle']!=first['handle']
    vault=VaultStore(owner_home/'vault')
    assert vault.resolve_secret(first['handle'])==vault.resolve_secret(second['handle'])=={'phone_number':'+919876543210'}
    PersonalStore(owner_home).save('phone',{'phone_number':'+12025550101','country_code':'+1'})
    existing=await service.request_access(turn(service),login_method='sms')
    assert existing['handle']==second['handle']
    # Changing a primary never rewrites a site's selected login number.
    assert vault.resolve_secret(existing['handle'])['phone_number']=='+919876543210'
    guest=await service.request_access(turn(service,'UB'),login_method='sms')
    assert guest['status']=='waiting_for_owner'
    assert VaultStore(service.private_home('TT','UB')/'vault').list_items()==[]

The private vault now has an Instinct-inspired Personal info section. The owner
can add, edit or remove one primary email, phone number and address. The phone
requires an international number; an optional calling code supports national
phone fields. Addresses include street, optional apartment and state, city,
postal code and country. The mobile address dialog keeps Save and Cancel visible
while the fields scroll.

Primary values use the native encrypted vault engine in a separate
`vault/personal.json.enc` file inside the requester's private profile. They are
not conversational memory, credential invitations or shared vault items.

details, save and remove endpoints. Ordinary listings return only availability,
a masked email, the phone's final four digits and a generic address summary.
The private owner form can load full values for editing; closing it clears the
fields. Personal values are not saved in browser localStorage or sessionStorage.

  the number again. The handler creates a normal encrypted login bound to the
  inspected HTTPS website origin. Existing website-specific numbers take
  precedence. `use_primary=false` opens the private form for a different number.
- Private password login forms offer the primary email only when the website
  login has no saved identifier. Existing website identifiers take precedence.

  owner's supervised local browser. It checks the exact HTTPS origin, browser
  ownership, visible fields, ambiguity and field length before filling. An
  explicit national phone field or a matching nearby calling code can use the
  national part of the number. Address input, textarea and select controls are
  supported through the native classifier and fill machinery.

  primary values. Personal values and the filled representations are registered
  with the existing browser/terminal output redactor in private turns.

# Reusable primary personal info

Implemented and verified locally on 6 October 2026. The live Slack gateway has
not been restarted to activate this feature or the preceding phone/SMS login
change. Real Swiggy/Nike login, SMS delivery and checkout remain untested.

The private vault now has an Instinct-inspired Personal info section. The owner
can add, edit or remove one primary email, phone number and address. The phone
requires an international number; an optional calling code supports national
phone fields. Addresses include street, optional apartment and state, city,
postal code and country. The mobile address dialog keeps Save and Cancel visible
while the fields scroll.

## Storage and owner access

Primary values use the native encrypted vault engine in a separate
`vault/personal.json.enc` file inside the requester's private profile. They are
not conversational memory, credential invitations or shared vault items.
Authenticated owner identity, same-origin requests and CSRF checks protect the
details, save and remove endpoints. Ordinary listings return only availability,
a masked email, the phone's final four digits and a generic address summary.
The private owner form can load full values for editing; closing it clears the
fields. Personal values are not saved in browser localStorage or sessionStorage.

## Reuse

- New local SMS sign-in requests can use the primary phone without asking for
  the number again. The handler creates a normal encrypted login bound to the
  inspected HTTPS website origin. Existing website-specific numbers take
  precedence. `use_primary=false` opens the private form for a different number.
- Private password login forms offer the primary email only when the website
  login has no saved identifier. Existing website identifiers take precedence.
- `clanker_personal_fill` resolves email, phone and address inside the requesting
  owner's supervised local browser. It checks the exact HTTPS origin, browser
  ownership, visible fields, ambiguity and field length before filling. An
  explicit national phone field or a matching nearby calling code can use the
  national part of the number. Address input, textarea and select controls are
  supported through the native classifier and fill machinery.
- Tool results report availability and fill counts without returning full
  primary values. Personal values and the filled representations are registered
  with the existing browser/terminal output redactor in private turns.
- The tool does not submit a form. Saving personal info does not authorize a
  purchase, registration or unrelated task. SMS codes remain fresh, temporary
  and single use through the existing private code flow.

Changing or removing a primary value does not rewrite or remove previously
saved website logins. This is stated in the owner form. Multiple saved accounts
on one website require deliberate account selection. Primary personal-info
fills currently require the supervised local browser; cloud adapters retain
their existing website-bound credential flows. Saving primary details in the
management page does not automatically resume a pending agent task.

## Verification

134 tests passed across personal info, vault, phone/SMS, both cloud adapters,
invitations, payments, channel tasks/control and native vault compatibility.
Python compilation and JavaScript syntax checks passed.

An actual Seatbelt Chromium probe ran A→B→A with two encrypted owner homes,
dummy contact details, owner-authenticated HTTP saves and controlled DOM forms
at two HTTPS origins. It confirmed repeated cross-site SMS, email and address
fills, national phone formatting, output redaction, wrong-origin refusal and
separate owner stores. No repeat contact form or Slack contact message was sent.
The HTTP tests also exercised CSRF, owner/origin rejection, durability, website
overrides and keeping personal entries out of invitations.

Playwright verified actual UI save, edit, remove, reload persistence, clearing
closed fields, browser-storage checks and mobile Save visibility. The verified
desktop, mobile and address-edit screenshots were added to the clanker
Lunagraph project's Page 1 and focused at Zoom to selection. They are exact
screenshots of the tested implementation, with dummy data.

- [Verification receipt](../../verification/evidence/2026-10-06-personal-info.json)
- [Chromium receipt](../../verification/evidence/2026-10-06-personal-info-browser.json)
- [Desktop](../../output/playwright/personal-info-saved.png)
- [Mobile](../../output/playwright/personal-info-mobile.png)
- [Mobile address editor](../../output/playwright/personal-info-address-mobile.png)

No real personal data was collected or saved, and no real account login, SMS,
purchase, Slack message or gateway restart was performed. The phone number in
the user's reference screenshot was not copied into the vault.

postal code and country. The mobile address dialog keeps Save and Cancel visible
while the fields scroll.

## Storage and owner access

Primary values use the native encrypted vault engine in a separate
`vault/personal.json.enc` file inside the requester's private profile. They are
not conversational memory, credential invitations or shared vault items.
Authenticated owner identity, same-origin requests and CSRF checks protect the
details, save and remove endpoints. Ordinary listings return only availability,
a masked email, the phone's final four digits and a generic address summary.
The private owner form can load full values for editing; closing it clears the
fields. Personal values are not saved in browser localStorage or sessionStorage.

## Reuse

- New local SMS sign-in requests can use the primary phone without asking for
  the number again. The handler creates a normal encrypted login bound to the
  inspected HTTPS website origin. Existing website-specific numbers take
  precedence. `use_primary=false` opens the private form for a different number.
- Private password login forms offer the primary email only when the website
  login has no saved identifier. Existing website identifiers take precedence.
- `clanker_personal_fill` resolves email, phone and address inside the requesting
  owner's supervised local browser. It checks the exact HTTPS origin, browser
  ownership, visible fields, ambiguity and field length before filling. An
  explicit national phone field or a matching nearby calling code can use the
  national part of the number. Address input, textarea and select controls are
  supported through the native classifier and fill machinery.
- Tool results report availability and fill counts without returning full
  primary values. Personal values and the filled representations are registered
  with the existing browser/terminal output redactor in private turns.
- The tool does not submit a form. Saving personal info does not authorize a
  purchase, registration or unrelated task. SMS codes remain fresh, temporary
  and single use through the existing private code flow.

Changing or removing a primary value does not rewrite or remove previously
saved website logins. This is stated in the owner form. Multiple saved accounts
on one website require deliberate account selection. Primary personal-info
fills currently require the supervised local browser; cloud adapters retain
their existing website-bound credential flows. Saving primary details in the
management page does not automatically resume a pending agent task.

## Verification

134 tests passed across personal info, vault, phone/SMS, both cloud adapters,
invitations, payments, channel tasks/control and native vault compatibility.
Python compilation and JavaScript syntax checks passed.

An actual Seatbelt Chromium probe ran A→B→A with two encrypted owner homes,
dummy contact details, owner-authenticated HTTP saves and controlled DOM forms
at two HTTPS origins. It confirmed repeated cross-site SMS, email and address
fills, national phone formatting, output redaction, wrong-origin refusal and
separate owner stores. No repeat contact form or Slack contact message was sent.
The HTTP tests also exercised CSRF, owner/origin rejection, durability, website
overrides and keeping personal entries out of invitations.

Playwright verified actual UI save, edit, remove, reload persistence, clearing
closed fields, browser-storage checks and mobile Save visibility. The verified
desktop, mobile and address-edit screenshots were added to the clanker
Lunagraph project's Page 1 and focused at Zoom to selection. They are exact
screenshots of the tested implementation, with dummy data.

- [Verification receipt](../../verification/evidence/2026-10-06-personal-info.json)
- [Chromium receipt](../../verification/evidence/2026-10-06-personal-info-browser.json)
- [Desktop](../../output/playwright/personal-info-saved.png)
- [Mobile](../../output/playwright/personal-info-mobile.png)
- [Mobile address editor](../../output/playwright/personal-info-address-mobile.png)

No real personal data was collected or saved, and no real account login, SMS,
purchase, Slack message or gateway restart was performed. The phone number in
the user's reference screenshot was not copied into the vault.
"}

"""Passwordless phone login: owner-bound HTTP, encrypted storage and scoped resume."""
import asyncio
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer

from test_clanker_vault import service
from agent.vault_login_classifier import LoginControl
from agent.vault_store import VaultStore, VaultError
from gateway.config import Platform
from gateway.session import SessionSource
from vault.service import Binding
from vault.store import RequestStore, AccessError
from vault.web import VaultWeb
from vault.login import normalize_phone, phone_fills, sms_otp_controls, sms_code_fills


def turn(service, owner='UA', task='phone-task'):
    source=SessionSource(Platform.SLACK,'D'+owner,user_id=owner,scope_id='TT',profile=owner,thread_id='100.1')
    return Binding(service,source,task,'Read my account status.',service.private_home('TT',owner))


def request(service, owner='UA', task='phone-task'):
    actor=turn(service,owner,task)
    return service.store.create(team='TT',owner=owner,home=actor.home,task_id=actor.task_id,
        source=actor.source.to_dict(),task=actor.message,kind='login',label='SMS account',
        origin='https://accounts.example.com',login_method='sms')


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_phone_and_sms_forms_are_owner_bound_encrypted_durable_and_resume_a_b_a(service):
    events=[]
    async def receive(event):
        events.append(event);event._gateway_accepted=True
        service.policy.adapter._session_tasks[service.policy.adapter._event_session_key(event)]=asyncio.create_task(asyncio.sleep(0))
    service.policy.adapter.handle_message=receive
    service.policy.adapter.gateway_runner=SimpleNamespace(_active_sessions={},session_store=SimpleNamespace(get_session_key=lambda s:'phone-session'))
    service.loop=asyncio.get_running_loop()
    client=TestClient(TestServer(VaultWeb(service,service.config).app));await client.start_server()
    try:
        for index,owner in enumerate(('UA','UB','UA')):
            row=request(service,owner,'phone-task-'+str(index))
            data={'id':row['id'],'token':service.store.token(row['id'])}
            sid=service.store.new_session('TT',owner)
            headers={'Origin':'https://vault.example','Cookie':'__Host-clanker='+sid,
                     'X-CSRF-Token':service.store.session(sid)['csrf']}
            other=service.store.new_session('TT','UB' if owner=='UA' else 'UA')
            wrong=headers|{'Cookie':'__Host-clanker='+other,'X-CSRF-Token':service.store.session(other)['csrf']}
            response=await client.post('/api/request',json=data,headers=headers)
            assert response.status==200
            assert (await response.json())['login_method']=='sms'
            phone='+1202555010'+str(index)
            for invalid in ({'phone_number':phone,'REDACTED':'x'}, {'phone_number':'555'},
                            {'phone_number':phone,'owner':'UB'}, {'identifier':phone}, {'phone_number':None}):
                assert (await client.post('/api/save',json=data|{'fields':invalid},headers=headers)).status==400
            assert (await client.post('/api/save',json=data|{'fields':{'phone_number':phone}},headers=wrong)).status==403
            assert (await client.post('/api/save',json=data|{'fields':{'phone_number':phone}},headers=headers|{'X-CSRF-Token':'wrong'})).status==403
            response=await client.post('/api/save',json=data|{'fields':{'phone_number':phone}},headers=headers)
            assert response.status==200
            assert phone not in await response.text()
            assert (await client.post('/api/save',json=data|{'fields':{'phone_number':phone}},headers=headers)).status==410
            service.store=RequestStore(service.store.directory)
            saved=next(r for r in service.store.pending_resumes() if r['id']==row['id'])
            vault=VaultStore(service.private_home('TT',owner)/'vault')
            meta=vault.get_meta(saved['handle'])
            assert meta.login_method=='sms' and meta.identifier=='••••'+phone[-4:]
            assert vault.resolve_secret(meta.id)=={'phone_number':phone}
            assert phone not in json.dumps(service.delegations.items('TT',owner))
            assert phone.encode() not in service.store.path.read_bytes()
            assert phone.encode() not in vault._vault_path.read_bytes()
            await service.drain();await asyncio.gather(*list(service.resume_tasks.values()))
            assert events[-1].source.user_id==owner and events[-1].source.chat_id=='D'+owner
            assert meta.id in events[-1].text and phone not in events[-1].text
            waiting=await service.request_code(turn(service,owner,'phone-task-'+str(index)),meta)
            code_data={'id':waiting['request_id'],'token':service.store.token(waiting['request_id'])}
            response=await client.post('/api/request',json=code_data,headers=headers)
            assert (await response.json())['login_method']=='sms'

import asyncio
import json

from test_clanker_vault import service

def turn(service, owner='UA', task='phone-task'):
    source=SessionSource(Platform.SLACK,'D'+owner,user_id=owner,scope_id='TT',profile=owner,thread_id='100.1')
    return Binding(service,source,task,'Read my account status.',service.private_home('TT',owner))


def request(service, owner='UA', task='phone-task'):
    actor=turn(service,owner,task)
    return service.store.create(team='TT',owner=owner,home=actor.home,task_id=actor.task_id,
        source=actor.source.to_dict(),task=actor.message,kind='login',label='SMS account',
        origin='https://accounts.example.com',login_method='sms')


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_phone_and_sms_forms_are_owner_bound_encrypted_durable_and_resume_a_b_a(service):
    events=[]
    async def receive(event):
        events.append(event);event._gateway_accepted=True
        service.policy.adapter._session_tasks[service.policy.adapter._event_session_key(event)]=asyncio.create_task(asyncio.sleep(0))
    service.policy.adapter.handle_message=receive
    service.policy.adapter.gateway_runner=SimpleNamespace(_active_sessions={},session_store=SimpleNamespace(get_session_key=lambda s:'phone-session'))
    service.loop=asyncio.get_running_loop()
    client=TestClient(TestServer(VaultWeb(service,service.config).app));await client.start_server()
    try:
        for index,owner in enumerate(('UA','UB','UA')):
            row=request(service,owner,'phone-task-'+str(index))
            data={'id':row['id'],'token':service.store.token(row['id'])}
            sid=service.store.new_session('TT',owner)
            headers={'Origin':'https://vault.example','Cookie':'__Host-clanker='+sid,
                     'X-CSRF-Token':service.store.session(sid)['csrf']}
            other=service.store.new_session('TT','UB' if owner=='UA' else 'UA')
            wrong=headers|{'Cookie':'__Host-clanker='+other,'X-CSRF-Token':service.store.session(other)['csrf']}
            response=await client.post('/api/request',json=data,headers=headers)
            assert response.status==200
            assert (await response.json())['login_method']=='sms'
            phone='+1202555010'+str(index)
            for invalid in ({'phone_number':phone,'REDACTED':'x'}, {'phone_number':'555'},
                            {'phone_number':phone,'owner':'UB'}, {'identifier':phone}, {'phone_number':None}):
                assert (await client.post('/api/save',json=data|{'fields':invalid},headers=headers)).status==400
            assert (await client.post('/api/save',json=data|{'fields':{'phone_number':phone}},headers=wrong)).status==403
            assert (await client.post('/api/save',json=data|{'fields':{'phone_number':phone}},headers=headers|{'X-CSRF-Token':'wrong'})).status==403
            response=await client.post('/api/save',json=data|{'fields':{'phone_number':phone}},headers=headers)
            assert response.status==200
            assert phone not in await response.text()
            assert (await client.post('/api/save',json=data|{'fields':{'phone_number':phone}},headers=headers)).status==410
            service.store=RequestStore(service.store.directory)
            saved=next(r for r in service.store.pending_resumes() if r['id']==row['id'])
            vault=VaultStore(service.private_home('TT',owner)/'vault')
            meta=vault.get_meta(saved['handle'])
            assert meta.login_method=='sms' and meta.identifier=='••••'+phone[-4:]
            assert vault.resolve_secret(meta.id)=={'phone_number':phone}
            assert phone not in json.dumps(service.delegations.items('TT',owner))
            assert phone.encode() not in service.store.path.read_bytes()
            assert phone.encode() not in vault._vault_path.read_bytes()
            await service.drain();await asyncio.gather(*list(service.resume_tasks.values()))
            assert events[-1].source.user_id==owner and events[-1].source.chat_id=='D'+owner
            assert meta.id in events[-1].text and phone not in events[-1].text
            waiting=await service.request_code(turn(service,owner,'phone-task-'+str(index)),meta)
            code_data={'id':waiting['request_id'],'token':service.store.token(waiting['request_id'])}
            response=await client.post('/api/request',json=code_data,headers=headers)
            assert (await response.json())['login_method']=='sms'
            assert (await client.post('/api/code',json=code_data|{'fields':{'code':'829471'}},headers=wrong)).status==403
            response=await client.post('/api/code',json=code_data|{'fields':{'code':'829471'}},headers=headers)
            assert response.status==200 and '829471' not in await response.text()
            assert b'829471' not in service.store.path.read_bytes()
            service.store=RequestStore(service.store.directory)
            await service.drain();await asyncio.gather(*list(service.resume_tasks.values()))
            assert events[-1].source.user_id==owner and 'clanker_vault_enter_code' in events[-1].text
            args=dict(team='TT',owner=owner,home=service.private_home('TT',owner),task_id='phone-task-'+str(index),handle=meta.id,origin=meta.origin)
            assert service.store.consume_code(**(args|{'origin':'https://other.example.com'})) is None
            assert service.store.consume_code(**(args|{'owner':'OTHER'})) is None
            assert service.store.consume_code(**args)=='829471'
            assert service.store.consume_code(**args) is None
    finally:await client.close()

        with self.vault.lock_for(turn.home):
            path, state = self.state(turn)
            if purge:
                names = list(state['sessions'])

                names = list({name for thread, name in state['threads'].items()
                              if thread.startswith(turn.source.chat_id + ':')})
            else:
                names = [session or state['threads'].get(self.thread(turn))]

                if name not in state['sessions']:

                state['sessions'].pop(name)
